details.description: Melia 1 is Speechmatics' multilingual speech-to-text model, offered for Batch transcription in the EU and US regions by setting the request's model field to "melia-1" with language set to "multi". Instead of requiring a language to be selected up front, it automatically detects the spoken language from 55 languages, handles code-switching mid-sentence, and labels each word in the output with the language it was spoken in. Speechmatics states Melia 1's accuracy matches its Standard model. As of Speechmatics' current documentation, Melia 1 does not yet support the custom vocabulary, confidence scores, speaker identification, or speech-intelligence add-ons (translation, summarization, etc.) that Speechmatics' Enhanced and Standard models offer.
advantages: Automatically detects the spoken language from 55 languages and handles mid-sentence code-switching without requiring a language to be selected, per Speechmatics' Languages documentation.
Labels each word in the transcript with the language it was spoken in, a per-word language ID that Speechmatics' other models do not provide, per Speechmatics' Models documentation.
Speechmatics states Melia 1's accuracy matches its Standard operating point, per Speechmatics' Models documentation.

Speechmatics' September 2026 changelog reports a model update giving a 2% relative word-error-rate improvement across many languages, plus fewer transliteration errors and better mid-sentence code-switching on Hindi-English audio.
disadvantages: Does not currently support custom vocabulary, confidence scores, speaker identification, or Speechmatics' speech-intelligence add-ons (translation, summarization, topic detection, chapters, sentiment analysis, audio events), which Enhanced and Standard both offer.
Available for Batch transcription only in the EU and US regions, per Speechmatics' Models documentation.
Speechmatics' Models documentation describes Melia 1 as an early-access model whose feature support is still expanding.
use_cases: Transcribing multilingual audio with mid-sentence code-switching
Multilingual meeting, call and media transcription where the spoken language is not known in advance
Localized transcript output using per-language word delimiters and writing direction

notes: Speechmatics' documentation is inconsistent on Melia 1's release status: the on-prem GPU container page describes only how the inference server currently runs ('currently runs in batch mode only'), with no GA/preview/beta label of any kind, so it was not read as a GA claim; the general Models page describes Melia 1's 'feature support' as 'expanding', language consistent with early access. A page claimed to mark a Realtime-only Melia 1 preview as 'early preview... GA targeted October 2026' could not be located on the current docs site (every guessed URL under speech-to-text/realtime/ 404s, and the Realtime transcription section's nav has no Melia 1 page); the Models page itself states Melia 1 is Batch-only today, so that claim was dropped from consideration rather than repeated. The disadvantage above uses only the general Models page's 'early-access'/'expanding' wording, which is confirmed current. The 55-language figure (corrected from a previously unverified '56') comes from Speechmatics' Languages reference page, which lists Melia 1 as transcribing exactly its 55 individually-listed languages (it explicitly does not support the bilingual/multi-language pack codes, so Tagalog, which exists only as a bilingual-pack entry, is excluded). Catalog carries no deprecation_date.
